subject.title: Feature Request: Add .gitignore-like exclude patterns to backup CLI

question: Should OpenClaw add native backup exclude-pattern controls now, and what defaults, protected paths, manifest behavior, and proof bar should become the core CLI contract?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but the permanent contract balances backup size, sensitive-file avoidance, and restorable archives; the open PR already concentrates that product and security decision.

options.title: Review linked PR as canonical
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle defaults, protected paths, manifest/JSON compatibility, proof, and conflict resolution before landing or narrowing it.

options.title: Narrow to explicit custom excludes
options.body: Accept only `--exclude` and `--exclude-file` first, while deferring smart defaults until restore completeness and security expectations are clearer.

options.title: Defer native excludes
options.body: Keep core backups coarse, document current scope and limits, and direct optional backup strategies to plugin or ClawHub paths after an explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/44288 to settle defaults, protected paths, manifest/JSON compatibility, proof, and conflict resolution before landing or narrowing it.
